purpose: Restore only the Docker disk headroom required by the accepted REG.RU preflight after exact-main canonical images are built, using the existing protected release controller and deleting only old unused canonical grainflow images while preserving current, rollback and exact-main authority.
approvedBy: repository-owner continuation of protected REG.RU release authority on 2026-08-12
requiredBehavior: owner-only command is bound to issue 3365 and exact current main
reuse the already installed pcactions NOPASSWD protected release-controller wrapper without changing the wrapper or sudoers
reclaim is a reserved one-argument maintenance submode of the existing deploy controller action and cannot accept freeform paths image names or thresholds
delete only local ghcr.io/pachaninm-lab/grainflow-api web migration or tai images that are unused by every running or stopped container
protect every image referenced by any container, every image whose OCI revision equals exact current main, and the two newest local images per canonical component
never remove containers volumes networks build cache arbitrary third-party images or model-host artifacts
stop reclaim when Docker filesystem available space reaches 6 GiB and fail closed if the hard 5 GiB preflight threshold is still not met
publish only bounded counts capacity and reclaimed-byte evidence without image ids paths credentials environment values or customer data
forbiddenCapabilities: docker system prune docker image prune docker builder prune or forced image deletion
docker container volume or network deletion
deleting an image referenced by any running or stopped container
deleting exact-main images or reducing the two-image rollback reserve per canonical component
changing the installed release-controller wrapper sudoers runner identity or Docker group membership
database application model-host deal role money registration or customer-data mutation
new server paid API SaaS or recurring cost
